name: Billboard
description: Floating Bars / 活动快捷浮动栏. A promotional band with one link, responsive campaign artwork and an optional text fallback for phones.

figma.notes: Modelled on the production yami.com homepage floating bar, which renders a 1585x160 artwork directly under the shortcut rail.

image.description: Campaign artwork with its intrinsic `width`/`height`, which reserve the band's height before it loads. `mobile` swaps in narrow artwork below 1024px, carrying its own dimensions. `alt` is usually empty because `label` already names the offer.

label.description: Localized accessible name. Required: the artwork's words are pixels, so without it the band is an unnamed link.

mobileTextFallback.description: Below 1024px, show label as readable text when no same-campaign mobile artwork is supplied. Uses the same destination and accessible name.

imageLoading.description: Artwork loading strategy; eager for a band above the fold.

focus.note: The link carries a token-backed focus ring at the band's radius.

radius.note: Consumes --radius-surface-default, matching the other homepage section cards.

tapTarget.note: The whole band is the target, far above the 44px minimum.

accessibility.role: labelled region containing a single link
accessibility.ariaPattern: section[aria-label] wrapping one a[aria-label] containing artwork or the mobile text fallback
accessibility.structure: The label names both the region and the link. The optional mobile fallback shows that same label as visible text.
accessibility.interaction: One link covers the band; there is no secondary target.
